title: The first st hydrate of an upgraded project says it wrote 0 files while its wrote: lines name the files it wrote
body:
Found by ic on 2026-11-20, re-driving st hydrate after st new at 908fea92d in a scratch V4 project on gyges. The first call printed "ok: <url> hydrated -- realised on its canon record, 2 file(s) on disk, 0 written by this run", followed by wrote: intent/st/<ID>/info.md and re-rendered: .../acceptance.md. So the count in the summary contradicts the lines that follow it, and AC-00.6's rule (a call that did something must not read like one that had nothing to do) is broken on the first hydrate in V4.

Cause: Facade::hydration's count leaves out the views that the realisation write itself renders.

Expected: the count equals the files the run wrote.

Owner: cc, who fixes it in this release (hv decision 69). Filed by vc for ic.
